stop_reason: Five genuinely distinct strategies exhausted without general resolution.

approaches.attempt: Classify all completed complementary pieces for finite two-sided compact leaves and analyze arbitrary leaf deletion.
approaches.proved_or_established: Theorem 1 and Corollary 1.1; cut graph is a path or cycle, with twisted endpoints allowed.
approaches.precise_remaining_gap: Infinite noncompact leaves and their complementary completions are not covered.

approaches.attempt: Identify every closed saturated subset using an invariant circle set and calculate each gap-stabilizer quotient.
approaches.proved_or_established: Theorem 2; all suspension sublaminations have I-bundle complements. A fixed manifold has both a negative product foliation and a positive vertical-torus example.
approaches.precise_remaining_gap: No reduction of arbitrary essential laminations to circle suspensions is proved.

approaches.attempt: Test whether intrinsic carrier incidence and positive weights determine the desired containment property.
approaches.proved_or_established: Proposition 3; identical one-sector torus carriers with weight 1 have opposite answers in distinct embeddings.
approaches.precise_remaining_gap: The embedding and complementary topology have been lost; richer embedded-carrier data are not ruled out.

approaches.attempt: Search for witnesses in finite regular covers and descend them using equivariance; eliminate equivariance for finite compact witnesses.
approaches.proved_or_established: Theorem 4 and Corollary 4.1; a deck-invariant witness descends, and finite compact orbit unions remain genuine by Theorem 1.
approaches.precise_remaining_gap: No general genuineness guarantee for a finite orbit union of arbitrary noncompact witnesses, or general witness construction, is supplied.

approaches.attempt: Attempt to combine finite splitting-history enumeration and genuine-carrier recognition into a containment algorithm.
approaches.proved_or_established: A search semidecides the existence of its finite certificates only; parallel carried slices demonstrate the literal containment quantifier mismatch.
approaches.precise_remaining_gap: Sound/completeness relation to the given lamination and terminating negative decision method remain unproved.
